rationale: xgb_topk_classifier failed catastrophically at default HPs (0/7, avg_ann -27.5%) — the per-date top-K-by-pnl label selects for VARIANCE not SELECTIVITY (avg_win +8-13% but WR 14-33%, DD often >20%). xgb_quarterly_dro remains the strongest baseline (3/7 default, +3.5% avg_ann); train mode should keep deepening its HP sweep on dro_strength × pass1_estimators_frac × weight_smoothing — three knobs barely explored beyond defaults.
